title: Trombonists and others who joined the alley sessions
summary: Barnes names Zue Robertson, George Field and Harrison Brasley as the trombonists who sat in with them.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Well, now, when you were all gathered there in the alley, would you be all clarinet players?
No, no, no, no. We have trombone with us, sometimes Zoo Rob, you know Zoo?
Oh, yeah. I knew him in California.
Talked to him a couple of times.
We have Zoo with us and sometimes George, how do you call him? Put your name on it. George Field?
George Field would be with us. And then we had another one that used to be with us, Harry Brasley. They were new here.
Well, we had different men with us.
